facts.fact: 晨醒：Toshiba 静电里 Erin 从 PAA beam——「I know why I made that episode now. I died so young. I should have been so much more…」；muscle memory 想抓空白带录 disturbance、克制住只盯屏；屏中 Erin 自白：「My whole entire life. I was just a speck. A bottle of anxiety and emotions. Clueless and nervous and afraid to ask for what I really wanted. Alone, under the stars, lost somewhere in the cinematic universe…」（ch08 童谣变体）
facts.anchor: He reached for her, the real her

facts.fact: Mary 与未来作证：David 冲下楼问 Erin（「去舞会了，以为她会见你」）抢钥匙狂奔如赴婚礼迟到；Mary 多年后自责（对 HBO 纪录片组）：「我记得他脖子上的淤痕——很新鲜、像挣扎过；当下没多想——David 从不像暴力危险的人——这恰恰说明他的 presence 有多 nefarious」
facts.anchor: I remember the bruises on his neck

facts.fact: 操场终局：舞厅烟机雾泄出体育馆漫过全镇；Erin 远处走向 end zone——林中霓虹=Jim 夏日描述过的 fabled video store 的 hulking awning 真身成形（goalpost 外林中、风吸成 frenzy）；「Erin, it's me!」她回头平静：「It's okay. I get it now. I'm not really here. I never was.」
facts.anchor: that hulking awning of the fabled video store

facts.fact: 被吸走：门铃响、店门爆开、风转向成全功率 cosmic vacuum cleaner——Erin 离地被卷入；尖叫、骤然 wide-awake 恐惧、抓草无 grip；Captain Video 吞下她、门砰合、铃再响、霓虹散回雾——店面蒸发带走 plane of existence 与挚友；Erin 离开时 screaming and crying for help、confused/jolted by suddenness——最后意识之问：「Was any of this even real? Had she ever even been anyone at all?」
facts.anchor: like a cosmic vacuum cleaner powered all the way up.

facts.fact: 阁楼新仪式：alibi 未经思考（「我去学校全找过没找到」）；入阁楼翻杂物寻出旧 CRT（Sony、与 Toshiba 几乎同款）；搬客厅插电、音量拧低、蹲屏前眯眼看静电——「Erin 走了、David 还在——独自继续共同的工作、监测 airwaves 等 next stray signal」；换台 hoping glimpse Erin/任何 modicum of hope——「someday 再见她、哪怕只在屏幕上」
facts.anchor: his family’s old analog CRT TV (a Sony, though otherwise nearly identical to Erin’s Toshiba)
